name: Police Emergency Helpline
description: Dial 100 to reach Pune Police immediately in any emergency situation involving threat to life or personal safety.

name: Women Helpline 1091
description: Toll-free 24-hour helpline for women in distress anywhere in Maharashtra. Operated by Pune Police Commissionerate for women facing harassment abuse or danger.

name: National Emergency Ambulance Service
description: Dial 108 for a free government ambulance in any medical emergency in Pune and Maharashtra. Available 24 hours.

name: Pune Police Bharosa Cell
description: Multi-agency support cell at Pune Police Commissionerate providing help to women children and senior citizens. Offers counselling legal guidance and complaint registration. Walk-in or call 1091.
location: Pune Police Commissionerate – Panshan Road Pune 411008

name: National Women Helpline 181
description: Toll-free 24-hour all-India women helpline. Connects callers to emergency police One Stop Centres and support services in Maharashtra.

name: Pune District Legal Services Authority (DLSA)
description: Free legal aid and advice for women and marginalised groups in Pune. Provides lawyers for court cases Lok Adalat hearings and legal literacy programmes. Services available at District Court premises.

name: Maharashtra State Legal Services Authority (MSLSA)
description: State-level authority providing free legal services to eligible women and citizens under the Legal Services Authorities Act 1987. Covers family law domestic violence and rights.

name: Sakhi One Stop Centre (OSC)
description: Government One Stop Centre under Ministry of WCD providing integrated support to women affected by violence – legal aid medical shelter counselling and police facilitation. Contact via Women Helpline 181.

name: Bombay High Court Legal Aid Committee
description: Provides free legal assistance in matters heard before the Bombay High Court. Women can apply for legal representation in appellate matters.
location: Bombay High Court – Fort Mumbai (covers Pune cases)

name: Protection Officer – Domestic Violence Act
description: Every district in Maharashtra has a designated Protection Officer under the Domestic Violence Act 2005 to assist women file Domestic Incident Reports and obtain protection orders.
location: District Women and Child Development Office – Pune

name: Sassoon General Hospital (B.J. Medical College)
description: Largest government hospital in Pune with free OPD and emergency services for women including maternity gynaecology and general medicine. Open 24 hours.
location: Jai Prakash Narayan Road – Agarkar Nagar Pune 411001

name: National Health Mission – Janani Suraksha Yojana
description: Government cash-assistance scheme for pregnant women delivering at government health facilities. Reduces maternal mortality and provides institutional delivery support across Pune district.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
description: Central government maternity benefit scheme providing financial assistance to pregnant and lactating mothers for the first child. Apply at Anganwadi centres or online.

name: Pune Municipal Corporation – Health Centres
description: PMC runs primary health centres and maternity homes across Pune offering free or subsidised OPD maternity antenatal and child health services.

name: iCALL Psychosocial Helpline (TISS)
description: Free professional telephone and email counselling provided by trained counsellors from Tata Institute of Social Sciences. Confidential support for emotional distress anxiety depression trauma and mental health.

name: Vandrevala Foundation Helpline
description: Free 24-hour mental health helpline providing crisis counselling in English Hindi and Marathi. Available to women and all individuals across India.

name: iCall Email Counselling (TISS)
description: Free email-based psychological counselling from TISS iCALL for individuals who prefer written communication. Suitable for those with limited privacy or time.

name: Pune Bharosa Cell – Counselling Division
description: Dedicated counselling support for women at Pune Police Commissionerate. Mental health counsellors work alongside police for abuse and crisis cases.
location: Pune Police Commissionerate – Panshan Road Pune 411008

name: iCall Marathi Counselling Support
description: iCALL helpline from TISS also supports callers in Marathi and regional languages providing accessible mental health support for women in Pune and Maharashtra.

name: Snehalaya NGO – Women and Children
description: Established NGO working since 1989 in Maharashtra providing shelter rehabilitation and support to women and children escaping abuse poverty and trafficking. Operates in Ahmednagar and partners in Pune.

name: Sakhi One Stop Centre – Domestic Violence
description: Government OSC under WCD Ministry offering immediate shelter medical legal police and counselling services to women survivors of domestic violence. Contact via 181.

name: Pune Police Bharosa Cell – Domestic Violence
description: Bharosa Cell at Pune Police handles domestic violence complaints for women providing counselling mediation legal referral and FIR assistance.
location: Pune Police Commissionerate – Panshan Road Pune 411008

name: Protection Officer Domestic Violence Act
description: Designated government officer in Pune to help women file Domestic Incident Reports and secure protection orders maintenance and shelter under the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act 2005.

name: Mahaswayam Employment and Skill Guidance Centre
description: Government employment and entrepreneurship guidance centre in Pune under Maharashtra Skill Development Department. Provides job placement career counselling skill development referrals and resume support.

name: Mukhyamantri Yuva Karya Prashikshan Yojana
description: Maharashtra government scheme providing 6-month paid internship-style job training across industries for youth including women. Apply through District Skill Development Office Pune.
location: Pune District Skill Development Office – Pune

name: SARTHI Skill Development Programme for Women
description: Maharani Saibai SARTHI Skill Development Program under Government of Maharashtra providing free vocational and technical skill training to women in Pune. Includes IT courses through COEP.

name: DAY-NULM Self-Help Group (SHG) Programme
description: National Urban Livelihoods Mission supports urban women to form Self-Help Groups access micro-credit and develop small businesses or livelihoods. Implemented through PMC in Pune.

name: Mahadbt Scholarship Portal – Maharashtra
description: Single unified portal for all government scholarship schemes for students in Maharashtra including post-matric scholarships for SC ST OBC VJNT and minority girl students. Apply online.

name: Savitribai Phule Scholarship (Social Justice Dept)
description: Maharashtra government scholarship supporting girl students from VJNT SBC and SC communities studying in classes 5 to 10. Aims to prevent school dropout.
location: Social Justice and Special Assistance Dept – Maharashtra

name: Free Education for Girls up to Class 12 (Maharashtra)
description: Maharashtra government policy providing free education to girl students up to Class 12 in government and aided schools reducing financial barriers for families.

name: Maharashtra Government Foreign Scholarship
description: State scholarship for Maharashtra-domicile students to study abroad at postgraduate or PhD level. Open to women candidates meeting eligibility criteria.

name: Savitribai Phule Pune University – Student Services
description: SPPU offers academic programmes scholarships and student welfare schemes for women in affiliated colleges across Pune district.

name: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana
description: Maharashtra government financial assistance scheme providing Rs 1500 per month to eligible women aged 21–65 with family income below Rs 2.5 lakh. Apply at Anganwadi centres or online.

name: PM Ujjwala Yojana
description: Central government scheme providing free LPG connections to BPL women to reduce health risks from indoor smoke pollution. Apply at nearest LPG distributor.

name: Manodhairya Scheme – Maharashtra WCD
description: Maharashtra government rehabilitation scheme for women and child survivors of rape and acid attack. Provides financial assistance up to Rs 10 lakh shelter legal aid medical support and counselling.

name: Swadhar Greh Scheme – Ministry of WCD
description: Central government scheme providing institutional shelter food clothing medical care legal aid and rehabilitation to women in difficult circumstances including domestic violence survivors.

name: PM Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
description: Government maternity cash benefit scheme providing Rs 5000 to pregnant and lactating women for first child. Apply at local Anganwadi centre in Pune.

name: Mahila Arthik Vikas Mahamandal (MAVIM)
description: Maharashtra government corporation promoting women's economic development through Self-Help Groups micro-credit livelihood training and financial empowerment programmes across the state.
location: MAVIM – Mumbai (state-level; offices in Pune district)

name: DAY-NULM Micro-credit Support
description: Urban livelihoods programme providing micro-loans and financial linkages to urban poor women through Self-Help Groups in Pune under PMC implementation.

name: PM Jan Dhan Yojana – Women's Bank Account
description: Government scheme providing zero-balance bank accounts to unbanked women with RuPay debit card and accident insurance. Apply at any nationalised bank in Pune.

name: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin – Financial Aid
description: Monthly Rs 1500 direct bank transfer to eligible women aged 21–65 in Maharashtra. Provides economic stability and financial independence to disadvantaged women.

name: Swadhar Greh Shelter Home (WCD Scheme)
description: Government-funded shelter homes for women in difficult circumstances under Swadhar Greh Scheme. Provides temporary accommodation food clothing and rehabilitation services. Contact via Women Helpline 181.
location: Maharashtra (contact via helpline for nearest centre)

name: Sakhi One Stop Centre – Emergency Shelter
description: Government OSC provides short-term emergency shelter (up to 5 days) to women affected by violence while arranging longer-term support services.

name: Pune Police Bharosa Cell – Safe Referral
description: Bharosa Cell at Pune Police provides immediate referral to safe shelter for women escaping violence or in crisis situations through coordination with shelter homes and NGOs.
location: Pune Police Commissionerate – Panshan Road Pune 411008

name: Mukhyamantri Yuva Karya Prashikshan Yojana – Internship
description: Maharashtra state scheme offering 6-month apprenticeship-style training placements in industries and establishments. Open to youth including women graduates and diploma holders.
location: Pune District Skill Development Office – Pune

name: SARTHI COEP Technical Internship for Women
description: SARTHI runs advanced technical training programmes at COEP Pune for women from target communities. Provides career-linked technical skills in IT and engineering fields.
location: College of Engineering Pune (COEP) – Shivajinagar Pune
